name: Bugis South
summary: South of the Bugis retail belt toward Beach Road / Nicoll — denser central living with EWL/DTL optionality and nightlife spill as the lifestyle tax.
body: Bugis South is the shortlist when central interchange access and walkable food matter more than quiet landed texture. The pocket sits south of the Bugis mall spine toward Beach Road / Nicoll gravity; housing mixes older walk-ups, mid-age condos, and selective serviced edges. Expats land here for car-light CBD hops and late food options. Watch-outs: weekend tourist spill, nightlife noise nearer Beach Road, and estate-specific FOC / refuse culture. Compare with City Hall for civic-core polish, Bras Basah for arts campuses, and Kallang Bahru when you want quieter mid-town nights.
